title: Iwaniec's linear sieve at the sifting limit and Jacobsthal's problem
summary: A Lean 4 formalization of H. Iwaniec, "On the error term in the linear sieve" (Acta Arith. 19, 1971) and "On the problem of Jacobsthal" (Demonstratio Math. 11, 1978). The headline result is Iwaniec's bound for Jacobsthal's problem: if m consecutive integers are each divisible by one of r ≥ 2 given primes, then m ≤ C (r log r)² for an absolute constant C. More strongly, every interval of length c ∏ (1 − 1/q)⁻¹ r² log r contains at least r² integers coprime to r given primes.
